ABOUT ME

Listening comes first.

I believe that every person has unique health concerns and wellness needs. I take time to listen, understand each patient’s concerns, and develop an individualized Traditional Chinese Medicine care plan.

I earned my master’s degree in Traditional Chinese Medicine at the University of East-West Medicine in California. I hold acupuncture licenses in Georgia and California and national certification in acupuncture and herbal medicine through NCBAHM, formerly NCCAOM.

Through acupuncture, Chinese herbal medicine, and other traditional therapies, my goal is to help patients manage discomfort, support overall well-being, and improve quality of life.

“Treat every patient with care and approach every treatment with dedication.”
My journey into Traditional Chinese Medicine+

My connection with Traditional Chinese Medicine began in childhood. An experienced Chinese medicine practitioner helped me when I was often in poor health, sparking my interest in this field. Later, the stories of Li Shizhen and his dedication to medicinal herbs and helping others strengthened my determination to study Chinese medicine. To me, this is both a profession and a way to care for others and serve the community.

Concerns you can discuss

You may discuss the concerns below with Ling Liu during an evaluation. Listing a concern does not mean acupuncture or herbal medicine can treat or cure it.

Pain & muscle tension+

Neck, shoulder, back, and joint discomfort; muscle tension and stiffness.

Sleep, stress & fatigue+

Difficulty sleeping, stress, tension, and fatigue.

Digestive concerns+

Bloating, indigestion, nausea, appetite changes, and bowel discomfort.

Women’s & men’s wellness+

Menstrual or menopausal discomfort, stress, sleep concerns, and age-related wellness needs.

Other concerns & supportive care+

Headaches, seasonal symptoms, skin concerns, and supportive care during recovery may also be discussed. Supportive care does not replace medical treatment.
